logp.method_description: The lipophilicity of metal-based drugs was determined by shaking bottle technique. The specific operation is as follows: first, the two liquid phases of octanol and water are mutually saturated; Secondly, appropriate amount of complex (0.2 mg) was added to the centrifugal tube, and 2 mL of pre-saturated two-phase solution was added to the centrifugal tube respectively. Thirdly, the mixture containing the complex was vibrated on a shaker for 24 h and left to stand overnight. Two phases of water and octanol were carefully separated into test tubes, and 50 μL of each phase substance was dissolved in 1000 μL HNO3, and then diluted with distilled water. The rhodium or palladium analysis was determined by ICP-MS. These procedures were carried out at ambient temperature (298 K). Partition coefficients of complexes were calculated using the equation log P=log([Metal]octanol /[Metal]aqueous), (Metal stands for rhodium or palladium).
